name: floss
title: FLOSS
description: Mandiant FLOSS 3.2: extracts obfuscated strings from malware - static strings plus stack strings, tight strings and strings decoded by emulating the sample's decoding routines (vivisect; the sample is never executed) - from PE files and shellcode, language-aware for Go and Rust. Samples are read from the folder mounted at /work. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, axross-mcp-hub) AND Apache-2.0 (FLOSS, vivisect)

mounts.description: The folder with the samples (read-only is enough)

notes: Emulation of large samples is slow and memory-hungry; axross's 512 MiB limit applies - use only=["static"] or a smaller timeout for big files.
